d:
I was waiting for someone to translate this work, but I decided to try translating myself. This is my first translation and formatting, so my command of Japanese isn't the best. I wasn't happy with some of the dialogue, but I just pushed forward. Let me know what you all think. If you like it let me know which other works I should try translating, and if you all hate it I'll delete the upload.

EDIT 7/21 - fixed some grammar and made formatting more consistent
